3.name: Divine Fury
3.notes: On each of your turns while raging, the first creature you hit with a weapon or Unarmed Strike takes extra damage equal to 1d6 + half your Barbarian level (round down). Each time you deal this damage, choose whether it is Necrotic or Radiant.

3.name: Warrior of the Gods
3.notes:
You gain a healing pool of four d12s. As a Bonus Action, expend any number of dice, roll them, and regain Hit Points equal to the total.
The pool regains all dice on a Long Rest.
The maximum dice increase at Barbarian levels 6 (5 dice), 12 (6 dice), and 17 (7 dice).

6.name: Fanatical Focus
6.notes: Once per active Rage, when you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it and add a bonus equal to your Rage Damage bonus. You must use the new result.

10.name: Zealous Presence
10.notes:
As a Bonus Action, unleash a divine battle cry. Up to ten creatures of your choice within 60 feet gain Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn.
Usable once per Long Rest, or you may expend a use of Rage to restore it.

14.name: Rage of the Gods
14.notes:
When you activate your Rage, you may assume a divine form for 1 minute or until you drop to 0 Hit Points. Usable once per Long Rest.

While transformed:
• **Flight** — Fly Speed equal to your Speed; you can hover.
• **Resistance** — Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage.
• **Revivification** — When a creature within 30 feet would drop to 0 Hit Points, you can take a Reaction and expend a use of Rage to set its Hit Points to a number equal to your Barbarian level instead.
